easy: A person who brings food and drinks to your table at a restaurant.

ex.en: The server brought us pancakes and a glass of milk.
ex.ko: 종업원이 우리에게 팬케이크와 우유 한 잔을 가져다주었다.

easy: A computer that shares files and other things with other computers.

ex.en: The school server saves all our class files.
ex.ko: 학교 서버에는 우리 반 파일이 모두 저장된다.

easy: The upset, frozen feeling you get when something bad happens suddenly.

ex.en: Mia was in shock when she saw her broken bike.
ex.ko: 미아는 부서진 자전거를 보고 충격을 받았다.

easy: A sudden jolt you feel when electricity goes through your body.

ex.en: I got a small shock when I touched the metal doorknob.
ex.ko: 금속 문손잡이를 만졌을 때 약한 전기 충격을 느꼈다.

easy: A time when nobody is talking.

ex.ko: 선생님이 들어오시자 교실에 침묵이 흘렀다.

ex.en: I love the silence of the woods in the morning.
ex.ko: 나는 아침 숲의 고요함이 좋다.

easy: Not saying anything when people expect you to talk.

ex.en: His silence told us he was upset.
ex.ko: 그의 침묵은 그가 속상하다는 걸 알려 주었다.

easy: A person who fights for a country in the army.

ex.en: The soldier waved to his kids before getting on the bus.
ex.ko: 군인은 버스에 타기 전에 아이들에게 손을 흔들었다.

easy: A kind of ant with a big head and strong jaws that guards the nest.

ex.en: A soldier ant guarded the entrance to the nest.
ex.ko: 병정개미가 개미집 입구를 지켰다.

easy: Very good; better than most others.

ex.en: Her superior drawing won first prize.
ex.ko: 그녀의 뛰어난 그림이 일등상을 받았다.

easy: Higher in rank, so you are the boss of someone.

ex.en: A superior officer gave the soldiers their orders.
ex.ko: 상급 장교가 병사들에게 명령을 내렸다.

easy: Wide from one side to the other, not thin.

ex.en: This book is so thick that it took me a month to read.
ex.ko: 이 책은 너무 두꺼워서 다 읽는 데 한 달이 걸렸다.

easy: Packed close together with very little space between.

ex.en: We got lost in the thick forest.
ex.ko: 우리는 울창한 숲에서 길을 잃었다.

easy: Not runny; hard to pour.

ex.en: Grandma's thick soup stuck to my spoon.
ex.ko: 할머니의 걸쭉한 수프가 숟가락에 달라붙었다.

easy: A change from one place, time, or stage to the next.

ex.en: Moving up to middle school is a big transition.
ex.ko: 중학교에 올라가는 것은 큰 변화다.

easy: Very rough and strong, and able to hurt things.

ex.en: A violent storm knocked down the old tree.
ex.ko: 격렬한 폭풍이 오래된 나무를 쓰러뜨렸다.

easy: To clean your body with soap and water.

ex.en: I wash my hands before dinner.
ex.ko: 나는 저녁 먹기 전에 손을 씻는다.

easy: To clean things like clothes with soap and water.

ex.en: Dad washes our soccer uniforms every weekend.
ex.ko: 아빠는 주말마다 우리 축구 유니폼을 빨아 주신다.

easy: Sour in taste, like a lemon.

ex.en: The acid taste of the lemon made me squint.
ex.ko: 레몬의 신맛에 나는 눈을 찡그렸다.

easy: A woman who acts in plays or movies.

ex.en: The actress forgot her line and giggled.
ex.ko: 여배우는 대사를 잊어버리고 킥킥 웃었다.

easy: Having to do with running a school, office, or group.

ex.en: The school's administrative office is next to the library.
ex.ko: 학교 행정실은 도서관 옆에 있다.

easy: A heavenly helper of God, often pictured with wings.

ex.en: We made a paper angel for the Christmas tree.
ex.ko: 우리는 크리스마스트리에 달 종이 천사를 만들었다.

easy: A worried, nervous feeling about something that might go wrong.

ex.en: I felt anxiety before my first piano recital.
ex.ko: 나는 첫 피아노 발표회 전에 불안을 느꼈다.

easy: Gym equipment with two bars side by side that gymnasts swing on.

ex.en: The gymnast swung along the parallel bars.
ex.ko: 체조 선수가 평행봉 위에서 몸을 흔들며 움직였다.

easy: Extra money a worker gets for doing great work.

ex.en: Dad got a bonus and took us out for ice cream.
ex.ko: 아빠가 보너스를 받아서 우리를 아이스크림 먹으러 데려가셨다.

easy: Making food ready to eat by heating it.

ex.en: Cooking pasta with Mom is my favorite Sunday job.
ex.ko: 엄마와 파스타를 요리하는 건 내가 제일 좋아하는 일요일 일이다.

easy: Something put over a thing to keep it safe or hidden.

ex.en: A blue covering kept the sandbox dry.
ex.ko: 파란 덮개가 모래놀이터를 마른 채로 지켜 주었다.

easy: Finding something for the first time.

ex.en: Our discovery of a bird nest made us gasp.
ex.ko: 새 둥지를 발견하고 우리는 깜짝 놀랐다.

easy: A thing that someone finds or learns about for the first time.

ex.en: Fire was a big discovery for early people.
ex.ko: 불은 초기 인류에게 큰 발견이었다.

easy: In Britain, a man with a very high title, just below a prince.

ex.en: The duke lived in a huge castle.
ex.ko: 공작은 거대한 성에 살았다.

easy: A man with a very high title in some countries.

ex.en: The duke gave a feast for the whole village.
ex.ko: 공작은 마을 사람 모두를 위해 잔치를 열었다.

easy: Making sure people follow a rule or law.

ex.en: Strong enforcement of the rules keeps the playground safe.
ex.ko: 규칙을 철저히 지키게 하면 놀이터가 안전하다.

easy: A sudden bright light that lasts a very short time.

ex.en: A flash of lightning lit up my bedroom.
ex.ko: 번개의 섬광이 내 침실을 환하게 밝혔다.

easy: A very short moment of bright light.

ex.en: I saw a flash of light from the camera.
ex.ko: 나는 카메라에서 번쩍이는 빛을 보았다.

easy: Following the proper rules and customs, not casual.

ex.en: We wore formal clothes to my cousin's wedding.
ex.ko: 우리는 사촌의 결혼식에 격식 있는 옷을 입고 갔다.

easy: Careful and proper, not casual, when you speak or write.

ex.en: Write a formal letter to the principal.
ex.ko: 교장 선생님께 격식을 갖춘 편지를 써라.

easy: A short math rule written with letters and numbers.

ex.en: We use a formula to find the area of a rectangle.
ex.ko: 우리는 공식을 써서 직사각형의 넓이를 구한다.

easy: The color between black and white.

ex.en: Mix black and white paint to make gray.
ex.ko: 검은색과 흰색 물감을 섞으면 회색이 된다.

easy: Wanting to eat food.

ex.en: I was so hungry after soccer practice.
ex.ko: 나는 축구 연습 후에 너무 배고팠다.

easy: Wanting something very, very much.

ex.en: He is hungry for fun after a week of tests.
ex.ko: 그는 일주일간의 시험 끝에 재미에 굶주려 있다.

easy: Knowing a lot about something.

ex.en: She is well informed about space.
ex.ko: 그녀는 우주에 대해 잘 알고 있다.

easy: Good and pure; not having done anything wrong.

ex.en: The baby's innocent smile made everyone laugh.
ex.ko: 아기의 순수한 미소에 모두가 웃었다.

easy: Not meant to hurt anyone.

ex.en: It was an innocent joke, and everyone laughed.
ex.ko: 그건 악의 없는 농담이었고 모두가 웃었다.

easy: The study of numbers, shapes, and how to count and measure.

ex.en: Math is my favorite class because I love puzzles.
ex.ko: 나는 퍼즐을 좋아해서 수학이 제일 좋아하는 수업이다.

easy: A big sports contest for countries around the world, held every four years.

ex.en: We stayed up late to watch the Olympics.
ex.ko: 우리는 늦게까지 깨어 올림픽을 보았다.

easy: A very big and fancy home for a king or queen.

ex.en: We toured a palace with golden stairs.
ex.ko: 우리는 황금 계단이 있는 궁전을 구경했다.

easy: A punishment for breaking a rule.

ex.en: The penalty for running in the hall is walking back to the start.
ex.ko: 복도에서 뛰면 벌로 처음 자리까지 걸어서 돌아가야 한다.

easy: A bad result you get because of something you did.

ex.en: He paid the penalty for skipping breakfast with a growling stomach.
ex.ko: 그는 아침을 걸러서 꼬르륵 소리가 나는 대가를 치렀다.

easy: An animal you keep at home as a friend.

ex.en: My pet hamster runs on a wheel all night.
ex.ko: 내 애완 햄스터는 밤새 쳇바퀴를 돈다.

easy: Taking pictures with a camera.

ex.en: I love photography and take pictures of birds.
ex.ko: 나는 사진 찍기를 좋아해서 새 사진을 찍는다.

easy: Making pictures using light and a camera.

ex.en: Photography needs light to make a picture.
ex.ko: 사진술은 사진을 만들 때 빛이 필요하다.

easy: A book, magazine, or paper that is printed for people to read.

ex.en: The school newspaper is a monthly publication.
ex.ko: 학교 신문은 매달 나오는 출판물이다.

easy: Printing and putting out books or papers for people to read.

ex.en: The publication of her first book made her happy.
ex.ko: 첫 책이 출판되자 그녀는 행복했다.

easy: Telling something to everyone so that all can know.

ex.en: The publication of the winners' names happened on Friday.
ex.ko: 우승자 이름 발표는 금요일에 있었다.

easy: A score or grade that tells how good something is.

ex.en: The movie got a high rating from kids.
ex.ko: 그 영화는 어린이들에게 높은 평점을 받았다.

easy: Deciding how good or how valuable something is.

ex.en: The rating of the science projects took all day.
ex.ko: 과학 프로젝트 평가는 하루 종일 걸렸다.

easy: Your place or level on a list or scale.

ex.en: Her chess rating went up after each win.
ex.ko: 그녀의 체스 등급은 이길 때마다 올라갔다.

easy: In the same order as the things you just named.

ex.en: Ben and Lily are eight and ten, respectively.
ex.ko: 벤과 릴리는 각각 여덟 살과 열 살이다.

easy: Planned for a certain time.

ex.en: The scheduled field trip starts at nine.
ex.ko: 예정된 현장학습은 아홉 시에 시작한다.

easy: Picked as one of the best.

ex.en: A select group of students sang at the concert.
ex.ko: 선발된 학생들만 콘서트에서 노래했다.

easy: Not saying anything.

ex.en: Everyone stayed silent during the test.
ex.ko: 시험 시간 동안 모두 조용히 있었다.

easy: Said out loud with the voice, not written.

ex.en: I gave a spoken answer instead of writing it down.
ex.ko: 나는 적는 대신 말로 대답했다.

easy: In a way that works out well.

ex.en: I successfully baked cookies without burning them.
ex.ko: 나는 쿠키를 태우지 않고 성공적으로 구웠다.

easy: To go through something bad.

ex.ko: 우리 팀은 토요일에 크게 졌다.

easy: To get hurt or sick from something.

ex.en: She suffered a cut on her knee when she fell.
ex.ko: 그녀는 넘어져서 무릎을 다쳤다.

easy: To stay behind others and not keep up.

ex.en: Our team trailed by two points at halftime.
ex.ko: 우리 팀은 전반에 2점 뒤졌다.

easy: To follow someone closely to catch them.

ex.en: The dog trailed the rabbit through the grass.
ex.ko: 개가 풀밭에서 토끼를 뒤쫓았다.

easy: To walk slowly behind others.

ex.en: Sam trailed behind his friends, kicking stones.
ex.ko: 샘은 돌을 차면서 친구들 뒤를 느릿느릿 따라갔다.

easy: The brother of your mom or dad, or the husband of your aunt.

ex.en: My uncle taught me how to fish.
ex.ko: 삼촌이 나에게 낚시하는 법을 가르쳐 주셨다.

easy: Coming to a place.

ex.en: We waited for Grandma's arrival at the airport.
ex.ko: 우리는 공항에서 할머니가 도착하기를 기다렸다.

easy: A person who has just come to a place.

ex.en: The first arrival at the party blew up balloons.
ex.ko: 파티에 제일 먼저 온 사람이 풍선을 불었다.

easy: Knowing that something is there or is happening.

ex.en: Her awareness of the danger kept her safe.
ex.ko: 위험을 알고 있던 덕분에 그녀는 안전했다.

easy: Not well; in a poor way.

ex.en: I sang badly, but I had fun.
ex.ko: 나는 노래를 못 불렀지만 즐거웠다.

easy: In a mean or unkind way.

ex.en: The boy treated his sister badly and had to say sorry.
ex.ko: 그 아이는 여동생에게 못되게 굴어서 사과해야 했다.

easy: Washing your body while sitting in a tub of water.

ex.en: I take a warm bath before bed.
ex.ko: 나는 자기 전에 따뜻한 물로 목욕을 한다.

easy: Real, and something you can see or touch.

ex.en: A tree is a concrete thing, but a dream is not.
ex.ko: 나무는 구체적인 것이지만 꿈은 그렇지 않다.

easy: Very strongly, in your heart.

ex.en: I deeply miss my friends from my old school.
ex.ko: 나는 예전 학교 친구들이 깊이 그립다.

easy: Far down into something.

ex.en: The whale dove deeply into the sea.
ex.ko: 고래가 바다 깊이 잠수했다.

easy: Words that make something easy to understand.

ex.en: The teacher gave a simple explanation of fractions.
ex.ko: 선생님은 분수를 간단히 설명해 주셨다.

easy: An idea that tells why something happens.

ex.en: The explanation for the wet floor was a leaky pipe.
ex.ko: 바닥이 젖은 이유는 새는 파이프 때문이었다.

easy: Telling how something works so it makes sense.

ex.en: I listened to his explanation of the magic trick.
ex.ko: 나는 그가 마술을 설명하는 것을 들었다.

easy: Being outside in weather like cold, sun, or wind with no cover.

ex.en: Too much exposure to sun can burn your skin.
ex.ko: 햇빛에 너무 오래 노출되면 피부가 탈 수 있다.

easy: Letting someone see or try something new.

ex.en: Exposure to music helped him love the violin.
ex.ko: 음악을 접한 덕분에 그는 바이올린을 좋아하게 되었다.

easy: Letting everyone find out a secret.

ex.en: The exposure of our secret plan made us giggle.
ex.ko: 우리의 비밀 계획이 들통 나서 우리는 킥킥 웃었다.

easy: Shown as a main or special part.

ex.en: The featured artist at the museum is from Korea.
ex.ko: 박물관의 이번 특별 소개 작가는 한국 출신이다.

easy: To promise that something is true or good.

ex.en: I guarantee this pizza is the best in town.
ex.ko: 이 피자가 동네에서 제일 맛있다고 내가 보증해.

easy: To promise that you will do something.

ex.en: I guarantee I will clean my room today.
ex.ko: 오늘 내 방을 꼭 청소하겠다고 약속할게.

easy: The good feeling you have when you are glad and everything is fine.

ex.en: Her smile showed her happiness.
ex.ko: 그녀의 미소는 행복을 보여 주었다.

easy: The joyful feeling you have when things are going well.

ex.en: Playing with my dog fills me with happiness.
ex.ko: 강아지와 놀면 내 마음이 행복으로 가득 찬다.

easy: Very bad and scary.

ex.en: The movie had a horrible monster that gave me nightmares.
ex.ko: 그 영화에는 나에게 악몽을 꾸게 한 끔찍한 괴물이 나왔다.

easy: As perfect as it can be.

ex.en: A sunny, calm day is ideal for the beach.
ex.ko: 화창하고 잔잔한 날은 해변에 가기에 이상적이다.

easy: A very short skirt.

ex.en: Her mini skirt was bright red.
ex.ko: 그녀의 미니스커트는 선명한 빨간색이었다.

easy: A very strong feeling about something you love.

ex.en: He plays the drums with passion.
ex.ko: 그는 열정적으로 드럼을 친다.

easy: Taking fruit or flowers off the plants where they grow.

ex.en: Apple picking was fun on our field trip.
ex.ko: 현장학습에서 한 사과 따기는 재미있었다.

easy: Happy about something.

ex.en: Mom was pleased with my report card.
ex.ko: 엄마는 내 성적표를 보고 기뻐하셨다.

easy: Feeling proud and happy about something.

ex.en: Dad was pleased when I rode without training wheels.
ex.ko: 내가 보조 바퀴 없이 자전거를 타자 아빠는 뿌듯해하셨다.

easy: The steps you follow to get something done.

ex.en: The fire drill procedure is to line up and walk out.
ex.ko: 화재 대피 훈련 절차는 줄을 서서 걸어 나가는 것이다.

easy: Pressing on something to make it move away from you.

ex.en: Pushing the swing higher made my sister laugh.
ex.ko: 그네를 더 높이 밀어 주자 동생이 웃었다.

easy: Smelling or tasting very bad.

ex.en: The rank smell from the garbage can made us hold our noses.
ex.ko: 쓰레기통의 지독한 냄새에 우리는 코를 막았다.

easy: Putting a new thing in place of an old one.

ex.en: The replacement of my broken bike chain took one hour.
ex.ko: 부서진 자전거 체인을 교체하는 데 한 시간이 걸렸다.

easy: A person who takes someone else's place.

ex.en: A replacement teacher came when ours was sick.
ex.ko: 우리 선생님이 아프셔서 대신할 선생님이 오셨다.

easy: No longer working because you are older.

ex.en: My grandpa is retired and loves fishing.
ex.ko: 우리 할아버지는 은퇴하셔서 낚시를 즐기신다.

easy: Tiny bits of rock found at beaches and in deserts.

ex.en: We built a castle with wet sand.
ex.ko: 우리는 젖은 모래로 성을 쌓았다.

easy: To rub wood with rough paper to make it smooth.

ex.en: Dad sanded the table until it felt smooth.
ex.ko: 아빠는 매끈해질 때까지 식탁을 사포로 문지르셨다.

easy: Decided for sure, with no more arguing.

ex.en: It's settled: we're going to the zoo.
ex.ko: 정해졌어, 우리는 동물원에 가기로 했어.

easy: A badminton game with one player on each side.

ex.en: Singles badminton is a fast, tiring game.
ex.ko: 배드민턴 단식은 빠르고 힘든 경기다.

easy: A tennis game with one player on each side.

ex.en: She won the singles match in tennis.
ex.ko: 그녀는 테니스 단식 경기에서 이겼다.

easy: A small label that tells you something about a thing.

ex.en: The price tag on the shirt said ten dollars.
ex.ko: 셔츠의 가격표에는 10달러라고 적혀 있었다.

easy: A sound recording kept on a long, thin strip.

ex.en: Grandpa still has a tape of his favorite songs.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 아직도 좋아하는 노래가 담긴 테이프를 가지고 계신다.

easy: The string held across the end of a race for the winner to break.

ex.en: She broke the tape at the end of the race.
ex.ko: 그녀는 경주 끝에서 결승 테이프를 끊었다.

easy: To pass a thread through a hole.

ex.en: Grandma helped me thread the needle.
ex.ko: 할머니가 내가 바늘에 실을 꿰는 것을 도와주셨다.

easy: Going to see a person or a place.

ex.en: Visiting Grandma on weekends makes me happy.
ex.ko: 주말에 할머니를 찾아뵙는 것은 나를 행복하게 한다.

easy: A wide street, often with trees along it.

ex.en: We walked down the avenue to the ice cream shop.
